facts: About 135,000 people (2020), the country's fourth-largest city
On the central plateau, about 62 km east of Bujumbura
worth_knowing: It was the seat of the Kingdom of Burundi and its kings until 1966. Parliament made it the political capital on 16 January 2019, while Bujumbura stayed the economic capital.
